summary: Last to announce. First under investigation. PNN examines a suspicious delay in the Black Webb Bandits' name reveal.
incidentDescription: The Black Webb Bandits were the final team to submit their name. Rumors of cold feet circulated. The word "chicken" was mentioned. PNN has opened a file to determine whether this was a failure of nerve or simply a failure to escape the panther.
suspectedMotive: Remain unavailable for comment until the coast was clear. Announcing a spider-themed team while a panther is on patrol may require delicate timing.

evidence.label: Exhibit A — A slight scheduling conflict
evidence.description: A panther traps a spider. PNN's playful reconstruction of why the Black Webb Bandits may have been difficult to locate before their name announcement.
evidence.caption: Illustrative PNN reconstruction. Not footage of an actual team incident. Eight legs. Remarkably few exit strategies.

investigatorNote: The spider connection is compelling. The chicken connection remains unsupported. Our working theory: they weren't scared to announce. They were waiting for the panther to leave.
disposition: Name recovered. Alibi pending. The Black Webb Bandits are officially on the board; the reason for their late arrival remains under investigation.
